responsibilities: Building informative reports and dashboards that deliver timely, accurate insights to stakeholders - supporting improved decision-making and driving tangible business results. You will be creating innovative Power BI solutions that enhance transparency and empower data-driven decisions.
Enabling self-service analytics by acting as a Power BI subject matter expert, educating users and promoting adoption of reporting best practices across the organisation.
Ensuring data integrity and trust by improving data models and championing data quality throughout the reporting lifecycle.
Delivering embedded analytics solutions by integrating Power BI insights into operational processes, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and streamlining workflows through automation.
Owning end-to-end solution delivery, from gathering requirements to building, testing, and deploying scalable data solutions that meet diverse business needs.
Exploring advanced capabilities like Microsoft Fabric and CoPilot to enhance analytics offerings and unlock strategic value.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensuring data integrity and trust by improving data models and championing data quality throughout the reporting lifecycle.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Accuracy, data integrity, data quality and testing recur across the bullets ('timely, accurate insights', 'championing data quality') with no velocity language.
evidence.domain_risk: Previous exposure to manufacturing and operational reporting is highly desirable.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The reporting serves manufacturing operations at a metals company, with no financial-reporting or regulatory language, so errors affect business decisions.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Enabling self-service analytics by acting as a Power BI subject matter expert
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A reporting function exists and is being extended ('improving data models', 'self-service analytics'), but nothing implies multiple specialised data sub-teams, so mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Delivering embedded analytics solutions by integrating Power BI insights into operational processes
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are specific to Power BI, embedded analytics and Fabric, while others are generic ('driving tangible business results', 'meet diverse business needs').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: educating users and promoting adoption of reporting best practices across the organisation
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is internal report consumers across the organisation, served through self-service analytics and user education.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns its Power BI domain ('Owning end-to-end solution delivery', subject matter expert) while delivering against requirements gathered from the business.
evidence.ai_role: Exploring advanced capabilities like Microsoft Fabric and CoPilot to enhance analytics offerings
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is asked to bring CoPilot into the analytics offering for users, so the AI sits downstream of the candidate's output; this is a weak signal.
evidence.testing_framing: championing data quality throughout the reporting lifecycle
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and testing are framed as things the candidate owns ('Ensuring data integrity', 'building, testing, and deploying'), not as listed tools.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and integrity appear in one of six bullets inside a delivery-led posting, so the risk register is secondary.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds new reports and embedded solutions and improves existing data models, with neither dominating.
evidence.language_gate: Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensuring data integrity and trust by improving data models and championing data quality throughout the reporting lifecycle.
